card.name: Space before a pressure or number value
card.fires_on: The space or first digit just before a number in cardiac and lipid text, most often a pressure threshold in mmHg after 'or', 'than', '>' or '<'. Also a few digits inside numbers such as years and counts.

modes.label: Space before mmHg value

card.writes: The suppressed tokens are pieces of words like thrombo-, fibr-, plate and anti-, so it seems to steer away from clotting terms and toward numerals.
card.plain: It fires where a number is about to be written, especially a pressure limit in heart-disease text.
